name: last30days-skill
description: Research a topic from the last 30 days across Reddit, X, GitHub, Digg, arXiv, Epic Forums, and YouTube.

settings.name: Extension Directory
settings.description: Extension installation directory (auto-set by Gemini CLI)

settings.name: xAI API Key
settings.description: xAI API Key for X/Twitter search (optional)

settings.name: Xquik API Key
settings.description: Xquik API Key for key-based X/Twitter search (optional)

settings.name: Twitter AUTH_TOKEN
settings.description: Twitter browser AUTH_TOKEN cookie for direct X search (optional)

settings.name: Twitter CT0
settings.description: Twitter browser CT0 cookie (optional, pair with AUTH_TOKEN)

settings.name: GitHub Token
settings.description: GitHub token to raise API rate limits for GitHub search (optional; gh CLI auth also works)

settings.name: ScrapeCreators API Key
settings.description: ScrapeCreators API Key, used only as the Reddit search backup when the free path returns no items (optional)

settings.name: OpenAI API Key
settings.description: OpenAI API Key - optional reasoning provider for headless planning/reranking

settings.name: Gemini API Key
settings.description: Gemini API Key - optional reasoning provider for headless planning/reranking
